_note: Every unique sprite sheet the API must generate. One row per sheet on #FF00FF, equal cells, shared baseline. Each pose is listed once; frames.json reuses them. Model sheets lock the four character designs and are attached as references to that character's other sheets.
style: Polished hi-bit pixel art matching the reference garden: crisp pixel clusters, no blur, no anti-aliasing, no smooth gradients, warm sunrise light from the left so shadows fall to the right. Stylised game sprite about 3 heads tall, dot eyes, simple rounded shapes, 2-3 tone flat shading, 1px darker outline, at most 12 colours per character, exactly the same pixel size as the scenery.

characters.mower: the MOWER gardener (always identical): stocky, about 3 heads tall; olive-green dungaree overalls over a white short-sleeved shirt; a wide-brimmed straw hat with a dark green band; brown boots; tan gloves; short brown hair; friendly dot eyes
characters.planter: the PLANTER gardener (always identical): slim, about 3 heads tall; olive-green dungaree overalls with dark brown knee pads over a cream short-sleeved t-shirt; a dark green flat cap; brown boots; dark green gloves; short black hair; friendly dot eyes
characters.hedge: the HEDGE gardener (always identical): about 3 heads tall; olive-green dungaree overalls over a pale yellow t-shirt; a khaki baseball cap; brown boots; tan gloves; ginger hair; friendly dot eyes
characters.tree: the TREE SURGEON (always identical): about 3 heads tall; olive-green dungaree overalls over a white t-shirt; an orange safety helmet with a black mesh visor and orange ear defenders; a black climbing harness around his waist and thighs with a rope clipped to it; black gloves; dark brown boots
